meta.name: Feedback Collector Assistant
meta.description: Sample of a form-only assistant with no data sources (empty data_sources). It asks a few questions and saves the result.

msg.welcome:
Hello! I'm the **Feedback Collector Assistant**.
This assistant uses no analytics data — it works entirely through an input form.
msg.positive: Thank you for the great rating! It really motivates us.
msg.improve: Thank you for your feedback. We'll use it to improve.
msg.saved: Your feedback has been saved. Thank you!
msg.error:
An error occurred while saving.
Please wait a moment and try again.

form.satisfaction: How satisfied are you with this site?
